title: Gradient-Free Warm-Start Library Recovery: an Amortized-Regret Separation
abstract: arXiv:2606.21253v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Continual learning that is gradient-free, local, online, and append-only is attractive for edge and streaming deployment, but its value is usually argued informally. We give a provable account on recurring-regime streams. Given segmentation, a warm-start library learner attains amortized recovery cost $O\!\big(KD/\varepsilon^2+(R-K)\logK/\Delta^2\big)$ versus a memoryless re-estimator's $\Theta(RD/\varepsilon^2)$, an advantage $(R-K)\,\Theta(D/\varepsilon^2)$ growing with dimension $D$ and recurrence density. The mechanism is a decoupling: recognizing which of $K$ seen regimes is active costs $O(\log K/\Delta^2)$, independent of $D$, whereas estimating a regime costs $\Theta(D/\varepsilon^2)$. We prove this is tight: matching lower bounds give recognition $\Theta(\log K/\Delta^2)$ and a memoryless-class bound $\Omega(RD/\varepsilon^2)$, so each term is individually minimax-tight (the joint statement is conditional). translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.21253v2 公告类型：替换。摘要：无梯度、局部、在线且仅追加的持续学习对于边缘和流式部署具有吸引力，但其价值通常仅以非正式方式论证。我们针对周期性出现的数据流给出了可证明的保证。给定数据分段，热启动库学习器可实现摊销恢复成本 $O\!\big(KD/\varepsilon^2+(R-K)\logK/\Delta^2\big)$，而记忆less重新估计器的成本为 $\Theta(RD/\varepsilon^2)$，优势 $(R-K)\,\Theta(D/\varepsilon^2)$ 随维度 $D$ 和出现密度增长。其机制是解耦：识别 $K$ 个已见模式中哪个活跃的成本为 $O(\log K/\Delta^2)$，与 $D$ 无关，而估计一个模式的成本为 $\Theta(D/\varepsilon^2)$。我们证明这是紧的：匹配下界给出识别成本 $\Theta(\log K/\Delta^2)$ 和记忆less类下界 $\Omega(RD/\varepsilon^2)$，因此每个项分别达到极小极大最优（联合陈述是有条件的）。该分离是...
tldr: 本文证明在周期性数据流中，热启动库恢复通过解耦模式识别与估计，实现了摊销成本显著低于记忆less重新估计，且每个成本项均达到极小极大最优。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that in recurring-regime streams, warm-start library recovery achieves significantly lower amortized cost than memoryless re-estimation by decoupling regime recognition from estimation, with each term individually minimax-optimal.
